extracted.name: Chewiest Brownies
extracted.description: Looking for the best chewy brownie recipe? These deliciously rich, fudgy, chocolaty brownies are irresistible and incredibly easy to make!
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees F (150 degrees C). Line a 9x13-inch pan with greased parchment paper.
Place sugar, cocoa, flour, melted butter, eggs, vanilla, and salt in a large bowl. Mix until well combined; it will be thick and sticky. Spread brownie batter into the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes. Cool completely; cut into squares and dust with confectioners’ sugar.
